ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white base (approx. 65%) with low-intensity black margins and internal streaking (approx. 35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions located centrally on both lobes. Black pigmentation concentrated along the distal trailing edge, leading edges near tips, and in a dense vertical band near the peduncle. Fine black linear clusters scattered throughout the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated pixel-level angle of 40 degrees; vertex is sharp.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large-amplitude indentations approximately 1/3 of the way from the notch to each tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the peduncle to the tips, with a slight recurve near the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High density of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white central regions of both lobes, more frequent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface rake marks across both lobes; distinct small circular dark ring on the interior white field of the right lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, dense cross-hatching pattern of dark scars on the left lobe.
